Vocabulary version 1. The source is `ontology/atlas.yaml`; only the owner approves changes to it.

## Node types

| Type | Group | Meaning | Kinds | Type-specific fields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Person (`person`) | core | Someone in the owner's life, as the owner sees them. The owner is also a Person, flagged is_self. | None | `relationship_to_owner`, `is_self` |
| Group (`group`) | core | A set of people: a family, an employer, a friend circle. | `family`, `employer`, `friend_circle`, `other` | None |
| Situation (`situation`) | core | An ongoing circumstance that could change or end. | None | `start`, `end` |
| Event (`event`) | core | One dated occasion, past or planned. | None | `when`, `precision`, `occurrence` |
| Feeling (`feeling`) | core | An emotion. | None | None |
| Sensation (`sensation`) | core | A bodily sensation. | None | `body_area` |
| Belief (`belief`) | core | A standing conviction about oneself, a person or the world. Judgements of people are Beliefs. | None | None |
| Behaviour (`behaviour`) | core | Something a person does. | `coping_tool` | None |
| Need (`need`) | core | What a feeling or behaviour seeks or protects. | None | None |
| Value (`value`) | core | What matters to a person. | None | None |
| Goal (`goal`) | core | Something being worked towards. | None | `progress` |
| Trait (`trait`) | core | A lasting characteristic of a person. | `strength`, `diagnosis`, `physical`, `other` (required) | None |
| Role (`role`) | core | A role or identity a person holds. | None | None |
| Pattern (`pattern`) | derived | A recurring sequence seen across events. Written only by analysis jobs, from phase 2. | None | None |
| Tension (`tension`) | derived | Two things that pull against each other. Written only by analysis jobs, from phase 2. | None | None |
| Blind spot (`blind_spot`) | derived | Something observed or inferred across sources that the owner has not named. Written only by analysis jobs, from phase 2. | None | None |
| Unsorted (`unsorted`) | special | Anything that fits no type. Stored with a suggested type and a reason, and kept off the map. | None | `suggested_type`, `reason` |

## Enumerations

### `speaker_role`

Who a voice belongs to.

- `self`: The owner.
- `therapist`: The owner's therapist.
- `other`: Anyone else.

### `statement_kind`

What sort of thing a statement is.

- `report`: What happened.
- `feeling`: How it felt.
- `reflection`: An interpretation or realisation.
- `intention`: What the speaker means to do.
- `observation`: A therapist's remark about the owner.

### `evidence_stance`

Whether a statement backs or disputes the thing it is linked to.

- `supports`: The statement backs it.
- `contradicts`: The statement disputes it. Both sides are kept.

### `evidence_basis`

How directly the statement names the thing.

- `explicit`: The speaker named it.
- `implied`: The extractor inferred it from what was said.

### `noticed_by`

Who has noticed a node or relationship. Computed from evidence, never set by hand.

- `self`: The owner named it explicitly.
- `therapist`: The therapist named it explicitly.
- `ai`: The extractor inferred it.

### `status`

How well established a node or relationship is. Computed from evidence, never set by hand.

- `stated`: The owner has named it.
- `observed`: Only the therapist has named it.
- `hypothesis`: Nobody has named it. Always labelled as a hypothesis.

### `record_state`

Life-cycle state of a node or relationship.

- `active`: In the atlas.
- `merged`: Folded into another node. Reversible.
- `retracted`: Left with no evidence after a retraction.

### `life_area`

The six fixed regions of the map, clockwise from the top, with Self at the centre.

- `love`: Love
- `family`: Family
- `friendships`: Friendships
- `work`: Work
- `body_health`: Body and health
- `self`: Self

### `source_kind`

What sort of input a source is.

- `therapy_session`: A recorded therapy session with the owner and the therapist.
- `voice_note`: A recording of the owner alone.
- `journal`: Text written by the owner.
- `archive`: An item from an existing archive (bulk import, phase 2).

### `source_status`

Where a source is in the pipeline.

- `uploaded`: Received, not yet processed.
- `transcribing`: Media and transcription stages are running.
- `needs_speaker_check`: Waiting for the owner to say which voice is theirs.
- `extracting`: Statement and concept extraction are running.
- `placing`: Embedding and map placement are running.
- `ready`: Visible on the map.
- `failed`: A stage failed and can be retried.
